name: Power Stones
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A while ago, I had an incident with the Shadowforge Dwarves.  They brought me to Angor Fortress to study two types of strange stones from Uldaman.  I discovered that the stones were sustained, stable power sources if treated correctly.  It's amazing the things one can find in that old dig site!

Anyway, after I told them the secret of the stones they kicked me out of Angor Fortress and began digging for more in Uldaman.

I want those stones for myself!  Bring me both types and I'll pay you plenty!
narrative.objectives: Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An'Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.
narrative.offerRewardText:
That's great, you found some!  Thanks a lot, adventurer.  You're the most dependable friend I've met!

I can't wait to try these on some devices I've been tinkering with.  I bet that, under the right circumstances, devices powered with these stones will keep going, and going, and going...
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the power stones, adventurer?  I have a robotic rodent that needs a power supply...
